   - **Flow-matching VLA**: π₀.₅ generates action trajectories via velocity field, noise interpolant x_t = (1-t)a + tε
   - **w(t) = σ(α(t₀-t))**: Sigmoid gating with t₀=0.5, α=10, suppresses collision penalty at high noise
